source.section: Standard Deduction Worksheet and Exemption Worksheet lines 1-8, 2025 Tax Rate Schedule and Worksheets PDF p.1 (marked DRAFT 10/01/2025); Instructions PDF p.10, Schedule M line 2a; Guide PDF p.19, Example 2 (Rhode Island bonds); Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = wages 250,000.00 = 250,000.00. Municipal interest is outside federal AGI. Federal taxable income = 250,000.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction = 234,250.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 250,000.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 0.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 10,000.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 10,000.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 10,000.00 - 0.00 = 10,000.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 10,000.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 250,000.00 + (10,000.00) = 260,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: worksheet line 5 = 260,000.00 - 254,250.00 = 5,750.00, not more than 29,000; line 6 = 5,750.00 / 7,250 = 0.7931034, raised to 1; line 7 = 0.8000. Line 4 standard deduction: 10,900.00 (Single) x 0.8000 = 8,720.00. Line 5 = 260,000.00 - 8,720.00 = 251,280.00. Line 6 exemptions: 1 x 5,100.00 = 5,100.00 x 0.8000 = 4,080.00. Line 7 taxable income = 251,280.00 - 4,080.00 = 247,200.00. Line 8 tax on 247,200.00 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 65,550.00 x 0.0599 = 3926.445000 = 11,755.82. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 11,755.82. Note: Federal AGI is 250,000, but Schedule M line 2a adds the other-state bonds, which lifts line 3 over 254,250. Rhode Island's own bonds are not on the federal return and are not added.
